rationale: Requests the last missing measurement for the event-backpressure finding: the same park at the shipped default event capacity (1024) instead of the small bounds witnessed so far, by adding a fourth case to the already-executed harness.

scope.description: Bound measurement at the shipped default event capacity: does an unconsumed event stream park nodes and stall the cluster when the capacity is left at 1024?
assumptions: in-process 3-node cluster, majority quorum, in-process transport under harness control
only node 1 consumes its event stream; nodes 2 and 3 leave the handle's receiver unread
writes are paced at one per millisecond so consecutive decided-index changes are observed in separate ticks
excluded: deployments whose clients always drain events
any latency claim about how long a real cluster needs to reach 1024 transitions

experiment.prefix: Same in-process 3-node cluster and actor setup as the executed revision (real OmniPaxos instances over MemoryStorage warmed by omnipaxos_runtime actors spawned with spawn_actor and a harness-local tokio-backed AsyncRuntime impl; one delivery task per node forwards outgoing messages to the receiver's handle_incoming). The new case drains events only on node 1 and leaves the default capacity in place (RuntimeConfig::default().event_capacity = 1024), then paces ordinary writes from the elected leader (one proposal per millisecond, 4000 proposals) so that the two unread nodes keep observing transitions until they reach the bound; it waits up to 90s for both to stop answering commands, then measures whether the healthy node 1 can still decide: it emits CA_EVENT default_capacity_parked_cluster {event_capacity,nodes_parked,decided_before,decided_after,append_notify_timeout_reached} and asserts that both unread nodes parked, that node 1 stayed responsive, that its decided index was unchanged across the attempt, and that at least 1024 transitions had been observed before the two nodes parked (so the bound really was the default rather than a smaller configured one).
experiment.revision_reason: Adds one case (`default_capacity_event_bound_stops_actor_loop`) and changes nothing else in the harness. The three existing cases are unchanged; the new case uses `RuntimeConfig::default()` unchanged (event_capacity 1024) to measure whether the park and the cluster-level stall also occur at the shipped default rather than only at the 64/8 bounds witnessed so far, which is currently a stated limitation argued from source.
